name: Asia Plus Group Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: Asia Plus Group Holdings Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities business in Thailand. The company operates in four segments: Securities and Derivatives Brokerage, Investment Banking, Fund Management, and Investment Trading. The company provides securities and derivatives brokering and dealing services for local and foreign investors; investment and derivative advisory; security underwriting; securities borrowing and lending; venture capital management; and private, derivatives, and mutual fund management services, as well as act as a financial advisor for the issuance and public offering of securities. It also offers investment banking services, such as mergers and acquisitions advisory, debt and corporate restructuring, and valuation services for shares, as well as invests in unit trusts and buys, sells, and exchanges securities. The company was formerly known as Asia Plus Group Holdings Securities Public Company Limited and changed its name to Asia Plus Group Holdings Public Company Limited in July 2015. Asia Plus Group Holdings Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
